subject: The 8PM moment 2,000 couples shared
preview_text: At exactly 8PM last night, 2,000 partners opened the app together. Inside: what happened next.
body_paragraphs: Last night at 8PM, 2,000 couples opened SoulPlan: Plan Dates Together at the same time. Not for a notification. Not because they had to. They opened it because one partner tapped 'cozy' on Tonight's Date and sent it over, and the other got that full-screen 'thought of you tonight' moment. Here's what happened next.

Within 90 seconds, those couples had a plan. No scrolling. No 'what do you want to do?'. Just a quiet, shared decision that turned a regular Tuesday into something that mattered. And here's the thing our data shows: couples who use Tonight's Date in their first 24 hours plan 4x more dates over the next month. Not because the app is addictive. Because the spark becomes a habit.

You already have SoulPlan: Plan Dates Together. Tonight's Date is sitting right on your home screen—one tap on a mood, and it's done. Your partner gets that beautiful moment. You get to feel like you remembered them without remembering anything. And the Memory Timeline? It fills itself, one cozy night at a time.

Open the app right now and tap the mood that fits tonight. Cozy. Adventurous. Playful. Healing. It takes 30 seconds. P.S. The streak counter has a no-shame freeze if you need a pause—but tonight, don't freeze. Just tap.
